title: Shoggoth wall art — round 10: one change at a time
notes: Swipe each: every card is A0 (your liked A, crown removed) with ONE change. Your likes tell us which changes to keep. Notes optional; sketches welcome, never waited on. ··· Why: round 09's studies applied several of our readings of your notes at once and all were disliked, while A was liked again — so we stopped guessing. Groups: T = tentacles, E = eyes, M = mouth, D = density, O = outliers (different pose or idea). Known build quirks: E1's eye adds a small lump; O1/O2 are rougher builds; O3's tilt is subtle. All keep: no crown, vertical maw, no stance, 3 shelves with 300 mm clear above. Canva concept art still needs credits on the Canva account. Not yet peer-signed: the CAD write-up for these studies (composition_r10).

cards.title: A0 — CONTROL: round-08 A, crown removed
cards.rationale: Your twice-liked A with only the crown removed (the one change you asked for outright). Every other card changes exactly one thing from this. Like = this is the base to build on.

cards.title: T1 — three distinct tentacles
cards.rationale: A0, with the three shelf arms replaced by tentacles of clearly different weight (heavy / medium / thin). Nothing else changed.

cards.title: T2 — one long curling whip
cards.rationale: A0 plus one long whip that leaves the right shelf, runs down the edge and curls — flow beyond the shelf.

cards.title: T3 — suckers on the arms
cards.rationale: A0 with a single row of octopus suckers on its existing arms. Nothing else changed.

cards.title: E1 — one big hooded eye
cards.rationale: A0 plus one large hooded slit-pupil eye beside the mask (its swelling adds a small lump at the upper left).

cards.title: E2 — cluster of small unhealthy eyes
cards.rationale: A0 plus 6-9 small mismatched eyes clustered off-axis on the trunk, some clouded.

cards.title: M1 — long fangs
cards.rationale: A0 with long fangs angled into the maw, a few broken. Silhouette unchanged.

cards.title: M2 — lamprey rings
cards.rationale: A0 with concentric rows of small hooked teeth lining the whole maw rim.

cards.title: D1 — sparser
cards.rationale: A0 with about half the webs and hanging strands removed — more bare wall.

cards.title: D2 — denser
cards.rationale: A0 with more webbing and strands (mildly — brackets your round-08 'too crowded' note).

cards.title: O1 — diagonal pose
cards.rationale: A0's character (ribbed trunk, webs, hanging cascade, maw) on the round-07 diagonal pose you liked. Rougher build than the rest.

cards.title: O2 — your ribbon pose
cards.rationale: A0's character on the sinuous ribbon from your original sketch (liked in round 07). Rougher build.

cards.title: O3 — slipping mask
cards.rationale: A0 with the mask tilted ~15° and displaced off the trunk axis, as if slipping off — a masquerade read. Subtle at small size.

cards.title: A — round-08 original, with crown
cards.rationale: The study you liked in rounds 08 and 09, crown included, for comparison.
